name: Corporate Woodworking, Inc.
old_description: When your project involves custom architectural woodworking and requires the use of a firm that can deliver and install the highest quality product in the timeframe needed, Corporate Woodworking, Inc. (CWI) is the only choice. As one of the Andersen Companies, along with affiliate Andersen Interior Contracting, CWI operates with the same dedication to customer service and strong relationships that are the hallmark of any Dan Andersen owned business.
about:
Corporate Woodworking, Inc. (CWI) operates from Fairfield, New Jersey, as a Dan Andersen–owned business within the Andersen Companies group. Andersen founded the firm in 1989 after earlier ventures that began in his basement in 1974 and included the sale of The Andersen Corporation in 1986 and the launch of affiliate Andersen Interior Contracting.

The shop specializes in custom architectural woodworking and millwork, producing and installing reception desks, wall paneling with exotic veneers or lacquer finishes, door and sidelight systems, and pantry/café/servery millwork. The company reports fabricating thousands of square feet of paneling and thousands of door systems annually, coordinating appliance and equipment integration with hand‑crafted millwork.

CWI serves the commercial construction and architectural woodworking sectors, working with architects, designers, general contractors, and building owners on corporate office fit‑outs. Typical projects include high‑end reception areas, blueprint‑matched wall panels, complex door hardware coordination, and food‑service millwork that requires precise equipment alignment.

The firm cites its AWI Quality Certification Program (QCP) membership and the “Andersen Way” philosophy—emphasizing relationships, integrity, agility, teamwork, and efficiency—as differentiators. The approach aims to make CWI a trusted partner that can adjust quickly to changing conditions while maintaining schedule and budget discipline.
